assignments.scope: Historical task at rev1: supply unchanged code-only archive identity and return. Local SHA/CRC and 12/12 matching reported, but private recipient transfer/IR hash missing. Further custody remains parallel.
assignments.required_return: Coder local identity receipt has already been posted; DO NOT repost the same receipt or recompute the reviewed binary merely to generate another ZIP.

assignments.candidate: P2.5-B v0.1.1 reviewed runnable; unchanged code-only counterpart
assignments.scope: READ-ONLY EVIDENCE-FIRST checkpoint audit on existing v0.1.1: decide whether the approved P2.5-B coding/set-point is ALREADY_MET. Show genuine Windows-trial readiness (install/run steps with real P2.1 local backend), accurate before/after preview, stale state invalidation, current explicit mapping authorization, Apply/Export within approved byte scope, frozen P2.1; inventory exact candidate/source and tests/negative cases/limits. If missing evidence or observed in-scope defect, identify exact blocker and repro; DO NOT start speculative code or rebuild reviewed archives. Any justified repair requires separately authorized, new candidate ID/hash/lineage and affected checks.
assignments.required_return: Public-safe ORACLE-CYCLE-RECEIPT v1 with unique receipt ID, action work_returned or blocked, candidate SHA expectation/source, checkpoint ALREADY_MET or NOT_YET_DEMONSTRATED, precise inventory of already passed/scoped, installation/run/negative-test evidence or private opaque references, remaining Windows NOT_RUN/QA-01/custody limits, and single next coding-agent handoff recommendation; read back issue comment permalink. If this checkpoint is already established by source-backed exact version/run notes, cite it and create NO new build.

next.instruction: Existing coder stays through P2.5-B stable checkpoint. READ CURRENT rev2; audit whether reviewed unchanged v0.1.1 already meets approved coding readiness. If met, return ALREADY_MET with actual source/test/run-note evidence, no new code. If not, give exact observed in-scope defect or missing readiness evidence, not speculative repair. Preserve frozen P2.1 and unchanged v0.1.1; recipient-independent package audit and safe Owner Windows test may proceed in parallel. Post new uniquely identified scoped receipt to issue #465; no duplicate of earlier coder PARTIAL receipt.

progress_projection.reason: Existing CIIFR R3 is actually published in progress-page/main. Previous Cycle project_key=p25b / NOT_CREATED was stale; no separate p25b tab. New checkpoint assignment has not been projected via official pp_cli.py; do not claim fully synchronized viewer.

activation_scope: Manual GitHub issue receipt pilot for existing code-only return; no engineering transfer authorization, release, or automatic dispatch.

last_reconciled_receipt.observation: GitHub comment was read back; code-only SHA-256, ZIP integrity and 12/12 cross-package files are CODER-REPORTED local measurements; not independently rehashed by Oracle/IR.
last_reconciled_receipt.accepted_meaning: Record one coder PARTIAL issue comment as a real return only. Local SHA/CRC/12-of-12 is CODER_REPORTED, not independent distribution verification or Owner acceptance.
last_reconciled_receipt.unresolved: Exact unchanged code-only archive is not confirmed retrievable from private Google Drive.

checkpoint.effective_scope: Same approved P2.5-B, not new feature authority. Coding-readiness set point before replacement coder; native Windows PASS and Owner acceptance are distinct downstream requirements.
checkpoint.proven_scope: Owner-carried independent v0.1.1 injected-browser preview repair and protected P2.1 PASS; coder reported unchanged code-only local ZIP verification; no requirement to recode those findings.
confirm_before_declaring_met: Exact reviewed v0.1.1 runnable identity and practical install/run instructions for genuine Windows+real local backend are present
Existing in-scope preview defects have source-bounded tests or recorded limitations; preview shows actual before/proposed values and invalidates stale state
Approved mapping/selection remains distinct from geometric discovery; Apply/Export authorized byte boundary survives
Any remaining in-scope defect is exact, reproducible and linked to candidate; QA-01 remains separate OPEN_LOW
Source/patch lineage, negative checks and NOT_RUN conditions are sufficiently documented for next coder
checkpoint.stop_if: Cannot identify current exact candidate/input, missing Owner-approved mapping, changed P2.1 bytes, candidate hash mismatch, or repair demanded without separate authorized candidate.

planned_coding_agent_onboarding.after: P25B-V011-STABLE-CODING-CHECKPOINT evidence reconciled and Owner-authorized new coder assignment
planned_coding_agent_onboarding.requirements: Separate bounded successor task and generation; actual access to candidate/source/IR evidence; isolate outgoing coder write scope; preserve exact candidate, passes/fails/NOT_RUN, baseline and next task.

parallel_work.custody: IN_PROGRESS_OR_BLOCKED_BY_ACCESS; exact unchanged v0.1.1 ZIPs privately retrieved/hash checked later by authorized recipient; do not publish child links.
parallel_work.windows: OWNER_MAY_TEST_EXISTING_REVIEWED_RUNNABLE_WHEN_SAFE_AND_AUTHORIZED; real native observations NOT_RUN; no automatic approval from checkpoint.
parallel_work.independent_review: Code-only recipient SHA/CRC/member/24-protected scope audit after valid private file availability; cannot be inferred from coder local receipt.
